cases.translation: Psalm of David, for the director of the choir.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession: the psalm of David.

cases.translation: Lord, You have searched and know me.
cases.explain: The verb знаешь (know) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Сажусь ли я, встаю ли, Ты знаешь, мои мысли понимаешь ___.
cases.translation: Whether I sit or stand, You know; You understand my thoughts from afar.
cases.explain: Издалека is an adverb modifying the verb понимаешь (understand).

cases.sentence: Ты вокруг ___ и впереди, и позади.
cases.translation: You surround me, before and behind.
cases.explain: The preposition вокруг (around) takes the genitive case.

cases.translation: And You lay Your hand on me.
cases.explain: The verb кладешь (lay) with the preposition на (on) takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: Your knowledge is wonderful for me.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) takes the genitive case.

cases.translation: Where can I flee from Your presence?
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я знаю, что Господь даст правосудие ___ и заступится за нищих.
cases.translation: I know the Lord will give justice to the poor and will defend the needy.
cases.explain: The verb даст (will give) with the dative case indicates the recipient of the action.

reading.ru: Господи, Ты испытал и знаешь меня.
reading.question: What does the psalmist say God does?
options: He searches and knows the psalmist
reading.correct: He searches and knows the psalmist
reading.explain: The verse states: Господи, Ты испытал и знаешь меня (Lord, You have searched and know me).

reading.ru: Сажусь ли я, встаю ли, Ты знаешь, мои мысли понимаешь издалека.
reading.question: What does God know about the psalmist's activities and thoughts?
options: Whether he sits or stands, and understands his thoughts from afar
reading.correct: Whether he sits or stands, and understands his thoughts from afar
reading.explain: The verse says: Сажусь ли я, встаю ли, Ты знаешь (whether I sit or stand, You know) and мои мысли понимаешь издалека (You understand my thoughts from afar).

reading.ru: Ты вокруг меня и впереди, и позади, и кладешь на меня свою руку.
reading.question: How does the psalmist describe God's relationship to him?
options: God surrounds him before and behind and lays His hand on him
God is only in the temple
reading.correct: God surrounds him before and behind and lays His hand on him
reading.explain: The verse says: Ты вокруг меня и впереди, и позади, и кладешь на меня свою руку (You surround me and before and behind, and lay Your hand on me).

reading.ru: Куда могу уйти от твоего духа? Куда могу убежать от твоего присутствия?
reading.question: What questions does the psalmist ask?
options: Where can I go from Your Spirit and where can I flee from Your presence?
reading.correct: Where can I go from Your Spirit and where can I flee from Your presence?
reading.explain: The verse directly poses: Куда могу уйти от твоего духа? Куда могу убежать от твоего присутствия? (Where can I go from Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?)

reading.ru: Твои глаза видели мой зародыш, и в книге твоей все мои дни были записаны, когда ни одного из них еще и не было.
reading.question: What does the psalmist say God knows about him?
options: God saw his development and recorded all his days in His book before any of them existed
God only knows the good days
God learns our days as they happen
God is surprised by what we do
reading.correct: God saw his development and recorded all his days in His book before any of them existed
reading.explain: The verse states: Твои глаза видели мой зародыш (Your eyes saw my development) and в книге твоей все мои дни были записаны (all my days were recorded in Your book).

reading.ru: Я знаю, что Господь даст правосудие бедным и заступится за нищих.
reading.question: What will the Lord do for the poor and needy?
options: Give justice to the poor and defend the needy
reading.correct: Give justice to the poor and defend the needy
reading.explain: The verse says: Господь даст правосудие бедным (the Lord will give justice to the poor) and заступится за нищих (will defend the needy).
